# General info: Overview of the event (species, stock)

```{r overview_statistics_info}
species_data <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openfigis/RefData/gh-pages/Eurostat/CL_SPECIES_1_2.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

spp <- unique(substring(ad_long_all$stock, 1, 3)) 

nome <- spp
resultados <- list()

nomes<-nome

# Ciclo for
for (nome in nomes) {
  if (nome == "mis") {
    resultados[[nome]] <- NA
  } else {
    resultados[[nome]] <- subset(species_data, ALPHA3CODE == toupper(nome))
  }
}


if (!is.null(resultados[[1]]) && is.data.frame(resultados[[1]]) && !all(is.na(resultados[[1]]))) {
  scientificname <- resultados[[1]]$SCIENTIFIC_NAME
  sp_name_eng <- resultados[[1]]$FULL_NAME_E
  aphia <- wm_name2id(name = scientificname)
} else {
  scientificname <- NA
  sp_name_eng <- NA
  aphia <- NA
}

overview_statistics_info <-c("ICES stock" =paste(unique(ad_long_all$stock), collapse = ", "), 
"aphiaID"= paste(aphia), "Species scientific name" = paste(scientificname),
"Species common name" = paste(sp_name_eng), "ICES WG" = "", "Age-based model"="")

# Table caption
set.caption('**Table 1.1:** Overview of the species from the event: ICES stock, aphiaID, Species scientific name, Species common name, ICES assessment Working Group, Stock category.')

# Output table
pander(style_table0(overview_statistics_info), missing="")

```




# Overview of the samples and stagers

```{r overview_statistics_stagers}

# Samples OVERVIEW #####################################################
histN=ad %>% subset(DoesSampleHaveHistologyImage=="Yes") %>% select(FishID) %>% unique() %>% dim()


overview_statistics_stagers <- c(
  "N. Individuals" = length(unique(ad_long$FishID)),
  "N. Images" = length(unique(ad_long$SampleID)), 
  "Samples histology (%)" =histN[1],
  "Preparation method" = paste(unique(ad_long$prep_method), collapse = ", "),
  "All stagers (n)" = length(unique(ad_long$reader)),
  "Basic stagers (n)" = length(unique(ad_long$reader)) - length(unique(ad_long_adv$reader)),
  "Advanced stagers (n)" = length(unique(ad_long_adv$reader)),
  "Countries" = paste(unique(ad_long$country), collapse = " and ")
)



# Table caption
set.caption('**Table 2.1:** Overview results of samples and stagers: Total number of samples (N. Individuals), total number of images (N. Images), samples with histology in % [Samples histology (%)], preparation method, number of stagers [All stagers (n)], number os basic stagers [Basic stagers (n)], number of advanced stagers [Advanced stagers (n)] and countries participating on the event.')

# Output table
pander(style_table0(overview_statistics_stagers), missing="")

```



```{r sample_overview}

# Table caption
set.caption(
  paste(
    "**Table 2.2:** Overview of the number of samples (num) by length category used for the exchange event number ",
    config$event_id,
    ". The range of maturity stages (mat_stages), modal maturity stages (modal_mat_stages), sex categories (sex_cat) and modal sex categories (modal_sex_cat) for those individuals within the length range are also presented.",
    sep = ""
  )
)

# Output table
pander(style_table0(sample_data_overview), style = "simple")

```



# Overview of the results
## Summary table: All stagers and Advanced stagers

```{r overview_statistics_all}
overview_statistics_all <-
    c( Data = "All", CU_sex  = cu_tab_sex_all[nrow(cu_tab_sex_all), "Total"],
    CU_mat  = cu_tab_maturity_all[nrow(cu_tab_maturity_all), "Total"],
    PA_sex  = pa_tab_sex_all[nrow(pa_tab_sex_all), "Total"],
    PA_mat  = pa_tab_maturity_all[nrow(pa_tab_maturity_all), "Total"],
    "All stagers (n)" =length(unique(ad_long$reader)))

# Table caption
set.caption('**Table 3.1:** Overview results: coefficient of unalikeability (CU) for sex (CU_sex) and maturity (CU_maturity); percentage of agreement (PA) for sex (PA_sex) and for maturity (PA_maturity); and the number of all stagers (Data: All) and advanced stagers (Data: Advanced) on the event.')

# Output table
pander(style_table0(overview_statistics_all), missing="")

```



